observations: Photo 0 shows a white Sony PS4 Slim console with a black DualShock 4 controller resting on top. The console has visible wear, including scuff marks and discoloration on the edges and surface.
The front of the console displays the 'SONY' logo on the left and 'PS4' on the right, confirming it is a PS4 model.

Photo 1 shows the same console from a slightly different angle, with the controller placed differently. The console appears to be held in a hand, and the background includes PS5 boxes and accessories, suggesting a retail or resale environment.
The console is white, matching the seller's description.
No disc drive is visible, consistent with the PS4 Slim design.
No screen or power indicator is visible to confirm functionality.
No games, cables, or power adapter are shown in the photos.
The seller claims it is 'hacked with latest games' — this cannot be verified from photos.

No screen, no interface, no visible software or game list. Cannot verify hacking or game content from photos.
